# Stepper

Indicate a progress inside a several steps process.
See [Stepper guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/stepper/design/)

### Step content

Using the `StepContent` component, you can build a vertical stepper behaving like an `Accordion` with the content displayed inside the steps.

<Canvas of={StepperStories.WithStepContent} />
